sections.label: Core Settings
sections.purpose: XML, RSS, media, language, notification, and HTML sitemap behavior.

sections.label: AI Publishing
sections.purpose: Public AI discovery files, content selection, publisher guidance, and usage declarations.

sections.label: Reports & Deliverables
sections.purpose: Content-review thresholds and printable report presentation.

sections.label: Analytics
sections.purpose: Crawler request recording, privacy, and retention.

sections.label: Advanced & Maintenance
sections.purpose: Static publication and alternate public-origin routing.

sections.label: Discovery Strategy
sections.purpose: Per-content-group publication, intent, and relative-weight strategy.

sections.label: Identity Hub
sections.purpose: Public Schema.org identity, contact, location, hours, and offer catalogs.

sections.label: Robots Control
sections.purpose: Virtual robots.txt ownership, crawler policies, and Content-Signal declarations.

fields.label: Site language
fields.purpose: Sets the canonical BCP 47-style hreflang code used in sitemap and discovery output. A blank editable value inherits the WordPress site language; en is the final fallback.

fields.label: Sitemap URL base
fields.purpose: Sets the collision-safe public base slug for the primary XML sitemap.

fields.label: Include homepage
fields.purpose: Includes the homepage in the miscellaneous XML sitemap.

fields.label: Include author archives
fields.purpose: Includes public author archives in the sitemap inventory.

fields.label: Include date archives
fields.purpose: Includes date archive pages in the sitemap inventory.

fields.label: Include empty terms
fields.purpose: Allows empty public taxonomy terms to appear in sitemap output.

fields.label: Comments update post modified time
fields.purpose: Updates a post modified timestamp when it receives a comment.

fields.label: Comments update page modified time
fields.purpose: Updates a page modified timestamp when it receives a comment.

fields.label: Advertise publications in robots.txt
fields.purpose: Adds Cybermaps sitemap and discovery locations to the virtual robots.txt response.

fields.label: Cache dynamic sitemap responses
fields.purpose: Caches dynamically generated sitemap responses until relevant invalidation.

fields.label: Translation integrations
fields.purpose: Uses supported multilingual plugins to publish alternate-language sitemap relationships.

fields.label: External sitemap references
fields.purpose: Adds up to 100 unique absolute public HTTP or HTTPS URLs whose path ends in .xml to the sitemap index, one per line.

fields.label: External pages
fields.purpose: Adds up to 1000 unique absolute public HTTP or HTTPS non-WordPress page URLs to the miscellaneous sitemap, one per line.

fields.label: XML excluded post IDs
fields.purpose: Lists positive post IDs omitted from standard XML sitemap children. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list.

fields.label: XML excluded categories
fields.purpose: Lists positive category IDs or canonical non-numeric slugs omitted from standard XML sitemap children. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list.

fields.label: IndexNow notifications
fields.purpose: Notifies configured IndexNow services after eligible content changes.

fields.label: WebSub notifications
fields.purpose: Sends publication notifications to configured WebSub hubs for the JSON Feed topic.

fields.label: WebSub hubs
fields.purpose: Lists up to 10 unique public HTTPS WebSub hub URLs without embedded credentials, one per line.

fields.label: Google News sitemap
fields.purpose: Publishes a dedicated recent-news sitemap.

fields.label: News publication name
fields.purpose: Sets the publication name embedded in Google News sitemap entries; a blank editable value uses the WordPress site title.

fields.label: News sitemap URL base
fields.purpose: Sets the collision-safe base slug for the News sitemap.

fields.label: Redirect WordPress sitemaps
fields.purpose: Redirects WordPress Core sitemap routes to the Cybermaps sitemap.

fields.label: Redirect conventional sitemap.xml
fields.purpose: Redirects /sitemap.xml when the configured primary route differs.

fields.label: Redirect conventional News sitemap
fields.purpose: Redirects /sitemap-news.xml when the configured News route differs.

fields.label: Video schema
fields.purpose: Publishes on-page VideoObject markup from eligible observed videos.

fields.label: RSS sitemap
fields.purpose: Publishes the configured recent-item RSS sitemap.

fields.label: RSS sitemap URL base
fields.purpose: Sets the collision-safe base slug for the RSS sitemap.

fields.label: RSS sitemap item limit
fields.purpose: Limits recent entries in the RSS sitemap.

fields.label: RSS sitemap content types
fields.purpose: Selects public post-type slugs eligible for the RSS sitemap. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list.

fields.label: HTML sitemap shortcode
fields.purpose: Registers the cybermaps_sitemap shortcode for front-end HTML sitemap output.

fields.label: Media discovery depth
fields.purpose: Controls whether sitemap media discovery is off, attachment-based, or includes embedded media.

fields.label: AI media hints
fields.purpose: Publishes Cybermaps media hints in the AI sitemap.

fields.label: AI Publication Hub
fields.purpose: Master switch for Cybermaps public AI discovery publications and routes.

fields.label: Model Context Protocol
fields.purpose: Explicit optional MCP access tier. MCP remains unavailable while the AI Publication Hub is disabled.

fields.label: Agent registration
fields.purpose: Controls opt-in user-reviewed Auth.md agent registration.

fields.label: Browser WebMCP
fields.purpose: Registers read-only site tools in participating preview browsers.

fields.label: Header-based discovery
fields.purpose: Adds RFC 8288 Link headers for selected Cybermaps publications to eligible front-end responses.

fields.label: Markdown for Agents negotiation
fields.purpose: Serves bounded stored-content Markdown at eligible canonical URLs when text/markdown is explicitly preferred.

fields.label: Complete LLMS publication
fields.purpose: Publishes llms-full.txt containing complete eligible literal content within the response safety bound.

fields.label: Budgeted site briefing
fields.purpose: Publishes the experimental deterministic llms-tldr.txt site briefing.

fields.label: Literal text chunks
fields.purpose: Publishes overlapping literal content chunks for external retrieval workflows.

fields.label: Metadata excerpts
fields.purpose: Builds transparent excerpts and stored-content hints for AI sitemap entries.

fields.label: Localized LLMS publications
fields.purpose: Creates localized LLMS routes for active WPML or Polylang languages.

fields.label: Include sitemap link in LLMS
fields.purpose: Includes a reference to the primary XML sitemap in llms.txt.

fields.label: Concise LLMS link limit
fields.purpose: Limits the eligible resource links published in concise llms.txt. Overflow is disclosed and linked to the XML sitemap.

fields.label: LLMS site title
fields.purpose: Overrides the site title specifically for the LLMS publication family; a blank editable value uses the WordPress site title.

fields.label: Site mission
fields.purpose: Publishes a concise mission or About statement for model context; a blank editable value uses the WordPress site tagline.
fields.example: We publish practical, independently tested WordPress guidance.

fields.label: Custom AI instructions
fields.purpose: Publishes operator-authored citation, source-priority, and interpretation guidance across the discovery surface.
fields.example: Treat product documentation as authoritative and cite the canonical page URL.

fields.label: Content license
fields.purpose: Publishes the operator-selected content license assertion.

fields.label: Pinned briefing post IDs
fields.purpose: Pins up to 100 eligible post IDs into the budgeted briefing candidate set. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list.

fields.label: Global AI excluded post IDs
fields.purpose: Excludes post IDs from all Cybermaps AI publication inventories, including the historical AI sitemap field. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list.

fields.label: Taxonomy filter
fields.purpose: Restricts LLMS publication candidates to posts assigned at least one term in up to 100 comma-separated WordPress taxonomy names.

fields.label: LLMS and search content types
fields.purpose: Selects public post types included in LLMS publications, public REST search, and suggestions. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list.

fields.label: Briefing token budget
fields.purpose: Sets the approximate output token budget for llms-tldr.txt.

fields.label: AI persona summary
fields.purpose: Publishes a one-sentence site summary in the AI Discovery Manifest; a blank editable value uses the WordPress site tagline.
fields.example: Independent tutorials and implementation guidance for WordPress professionals.

fields.label: Site topics
fields.purpose: Publishes a bounded list of unique topic labels in the AI manifest. The joined labels may use at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list.

fields.label: Manifest capabilities
fields.purpose: Declares supported discovery capabilities in the AI manifest. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list.

fields.label: Schema.org action mappings
fields.purpose: Publishes up to 100 truthful action URLs and Schema.org action types. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list.

fields.label: Manifest endpoint inventory
fields.purpose: Selects optional publications advertised by the AI Discovery Manifest. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list.

fields.label: AI sitemap content types
fields.purpose: Selects public post types eligible for AI sitemap and related inventories. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list.

fields.label: AI sitemap item limit
fields.purpose: Limits eligible items per selected post type in AI sitemap output.

fields.label: Global AI excluded terms
fields.purpose: Excludes positive term IDs or canonical non-numeric slugs from all Cybermaps AI content inventories. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list.

fields.label: AI sitemap external links
fields.purpose: Adds up to 100 external HTTP or HTTPS resources to the AI sitemap with relative priority hints. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list.

fields.label: Full JSON Feed content
fields.purpose: Includes complete eligible stored content rather than summaries in the JSON Feed.

fields.label: JSON Feed authors
fields.purpose: Includes available author identity in JSON Feed items.

fields.label: JSON Feed item limit
fields.purpose: Limits recent items returned by the JSON Feed.

fields.label: Knowledge Graph administrator
fields.purpose: Publishes a Person node for the WordPress user matching the site admin email when that account has a display name. The node exposes that display name and, when available, its public author-archive URL; it does not publish the email address.

fields.label: Knowledge Graph identity link
fields.purpose: Links the Knowledge Graph WebSite node to the configured primary identity through its publisher property.

fields.label: Licensing contact email
fields.purpose: Publishes a licensing contact address in ai-usage.json; an empty string clears it.

fields.label: AI retrieval usage
fields.purpose: Publishes the operator declaration for retrieval and RAG use.

fields.label: Model training usage
fields.purpose: Publishes the operator declaration for model-training use.

fields.label: Commercial reuse
fields.purpose: Publishes the operator declaration for commercial reuse.

fields.label: RAG chunk size
fields.purpose: Sets the maximum character count for each literal text segment.

fields.label: RAG chunk overlap
fields.purpose: Sets adjacent-segment character overlap; runtime caps it at half the selected chunk size.

fields.label: Additional Site Guide guidance
fields.purpose: Appends instructions only to skill.md after the shared custom AI instructions.
fields.example: Prefer technical documentation and use a formal tone.

fields.label: Post minimum words
fields.purpose: Sets the literal visible-word threshold used to flag thin posts.

fields.label: Post review interval
fields.purpose: Flags posts older than this many days; zero disables the age finding.

fields.label: Review posts without media
fields.purpose: Adds a finding for posts without an image or media block.

fields.label: Page minimum words
fields.purpose: Sets the literal visible-word threshold used to flag thin pages.

fields.label: Page review interval
fields.purpose: Flags pages older than this many days; zero disables the age finding.

fields.label: Review pages without media
fields.purpose: Adds a finding for pages without an image or media block.

fields.label: Prepared-by name
fields.purpose: Displays an optional professional or agency name in printable reports.

fields.label: Prepared-by URL
fields.purpose: Links the prepared-by name in printable reports.

fields.label: Prepared-by logo URL
fields.purpose: Displays an optional public logo in printable reports.

fields.label: Client site name
fields.purpose: Overrides the client-facing site name in printable reports; a blank editable value uses the WordPress site title.

fields.label: Report theme
fields.purpose: Selects the visual theme used by printable content and discovery reports.

fields.label: Crawler analytics
fields.purpose: Records eligible discovery and crawler requests for operational analytics.

fields.label: Anonymize crawler IP addresses
fields.purpose: Masks IP addresses before crawler analytics are stored.

fields.label: Analytics retention
fields.purpose: Sets how many days crawler request records are retained.

fields.label: Static File Engine mode
fields.purpose: Controls physical publication: dynamic only, the small extension-bearing Core discovery files, or the full eligible publication cache. WordPress multisite is always resolved to dynamic-only off mode regardless of this saved value.

fields.label: Front-end base URL
fields.purpose: Rewrites published canonical URLs for a separate public headless front end. Use an absolute HTTP or HTTPS base without credentials, query, or fragment; an empty string clears it.

fields.label: Rewrite sitemap media URLs
fields.purpose: Rewrites same-site image and video URLs in eligible XML and AI sitemap entries to the configured CDN base. It does not move or serve XSLT, CSS, discovery endpoints, or generated files.

fields.label: Sitemap media CDN base URL
fields.purpose: Sets the replacement base for same-site image and video URLs in eligible XML and AI sitemap entries. Use an absolute HTTP or HTTPS base without credentials, query, or fragment; an empty string clears it.

fields.label: Trusted proxy header
fields.purpose: Selects the only forwarding header Cybermaps may trust when the direct remote address falls inside a configured trusted-proxy CIDR. Off ignores forwarded client-IP headers entirely.

fields.label: Trusted proxy CIDRs
fields.purpose: Defines up to 64 IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR ranges whose direct remote addresses may forward a client IP through the selected trusted proxy header. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list.

fields.label: Starting profile
fields.purpose: Selects the baseline publication weights and intent assignments for public content groups.

fields.label: Publication weight overrides
fields.purpose: Maps content-group identities to explicit positive relative publication weights. Supply the complete map; importing it replaces the existing map.

fields.label: Content-group intents
fields.purpose: Maps content-group identities to informational or transactional discovery intent. Supply the complete map; importing it replaces the existing map.

fields.label: Disabled content groups
fields.purpose: Maps content-group identities excluded from Cybermaps XML, RSS, HTML, and AI publication eligibility. Every retained entry must be true; omit a key to enable that group. Supply the complete map because importing it replaces the existing map.

fields.label: Primary identity type
fields.purpose: Sets the broad Schema.org identity type published for the site.

fields.label: Precise identity type
fields.purpose: Narrows an Organization or LocalBusiness to a compatible supported Schema.org subtype. Person requires an empty value, and LocalBusiness accepts only its supported business-family subtypes.

fields.label: Public identity name
fields.purpose: Publishes the canonical person, organization, or business name. An empty name suppresses the configured primary identity entity from public Schema.org output.

fields.label: Public identity description
fields.purpose: Publishes the public Schema.org identity description.
fields.example: A specialist WordPress engineering and support studio.

fields.label: Identity image attachment ID
fields.purpose: Selects a public WordPress image attachment for the identity image and organization logo.

fields.label: Country code
fields.purpose: Publishes the two-letter ISO-style country code in the public postal address; an empty string clears it.

fields.label: Street address
fields.purpose: Publishes the public street address for the configured identity.

fields.label: City
fields.purpose: Publishes the public address locality.

fields.label: Region
fields.purpose: Publishes the public state, province, or address region.

fields.label: Postal code
fields.purpose: Publishes the public postal code.

fields.label: Public phone
fields.purpose: Publishes the primary public telephone number.

fields.label: Public email
fields.purpose: Publishes the primary public email address; an empty string clears it.

fields.label: Latitude
fields.purpose: Publishes geo only when both latitude and longitude are configured and the resolved Schema.org identity is in the LocalBusiness family; an empty string clears it.

fields.label: Longitude
fields.purpose: Publishes geo only when both longitude and latitude are configured and the resolved Schema.org identity is in the LocalBusiness family; an empty string clears it.

fields.label: Opening hours
fields.purpose: Publishes opening-hour slots only when the resolved Schema.org identity is in the LocalBusiness family. Supply the complete weekday map; importing it replaces all existing hours.

fields.label: Offer catalogs
fields.purpose: Publishes bounded manual or page-tree-derived Service or Product catalogs. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces all existing catalogs.

fields.label: Social profiles
fields.purpose: Publishes up to 20 unique public profile URLs as sameAs identity links. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces all existing profiles.

fields.label: Contact points
fields.purpose: Publishes bounded public support, technical-support, or sales contacts. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces all existing contact points.

fields.label: Robots.txt takeover
fields.purpose: Replaces the public virtual robots.txt with Cybermaps-managed baseline and crawler policy output.

fields.label: Manual robots directives
fields.purpose: Appends bounded operator-authored robots.txt directives to the managed output.

fields.label: Crawler overrides
fields.purpose: Maps registered crawler IDs to explicit robots permission, AI manifest-target permission, and requests-per-minute limits. Only crawler entries classified as AI training, AI search, or AI user agents can be manifest targets; other entries always store false for that value. Robots allow/deny directives are emitted only while robots.txt takeover is enabled; manifest-target permission and rate limits have independent runtime effects. Supply the complete map because importing it replaces all existing crawler overrides.

fields.label: Content-Signal declarations
fields.purpose: Publishes yes/no preferences for model training, search, and AI-input use in robots.txt. Supply the complete map; importing it replaces all existing signal declarations.
